breakdown.description: The simulation is for natural convection in a fluid layer heated from below (along Z-axis), but gravity is applied horizontally (in the -X direction), which will not drive the vertical buoyant instability.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to correct the direction of the gravity vector. The simulation is for Rayleigh-Bénard convection with heating from below along the Z-axis, which requires gravity to act vertically to drive buoyancy. The Agent specified gravity horizontally (`g (-9.81 0 0);`), repeating the user's error instead of correcting it to act along the Z-axis (e.g., `g (0 0 -9.81);`).
